title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・伸び悩みの理由

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ohhhhh… I lost. But… But…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Opera O! This is a win for the both of us.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Indeed it is! Without your presence, I could not have tasted victory. I must hand it to you, Doto, you were very close behind.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Hey, Doto and Opera O are getting pretty good. You think they're up there with the Ultimate Generation?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Nah, they're not that fast. Today's race felt a little sluggish to me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch, the results fit perfectly with my calculations.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It's like watching a wind tunnel test. Opera O is in the lead and Doto is struggling to keep up.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yet the Ultimate Generation are out there screwing up the whole meaning of "top." Those two can hardly compare.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um, Opera O! Does this mean… Does this mean I passed?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: And by "passed," I mean… am I shining bright? Bright enough to be considered your partner?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: That goes without saying, Doto! You are like my right arm, irreplaceable to me!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, would you care to run in the Japan Cup next? We need something to preface our generational takeover at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: There we will display our unbreakable bond to the world! Haaah ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Sure th-thing, Opera O. Oh, I'm so glad…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Thanks to your help, Opera O told me I was like her right arm.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I get the feeling I should have pushed myself a little more… But it's okay, because Opera O approves of me. Hehe…
With that… I have my answer.
And it turns out it was right in front of me all along.
The ceiling holding her back… is the very reason she's made it this far—her salvation, so to speak.
It's her feelings toward T.M. Opera O—and her reservations.
There's only one individual I can look to for advice. I ask Admire Vega her opinion on the matter.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's just as I thought… This race has made it clear.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: To speak the truth, Doto's never had confidence. Not even now.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: This entire time, everything she thinks can be traced back to Opera O—supporting, following, and getting her approval.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: She even relies on Opera O to determine if she shines.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: But that lack of confidence and her resulting stagnation are also affecting Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: At present, T.M. Opera O is one of the faces of the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: She needs a strong rival to push her limits too. Ideally, she and Doto would inspire each other, but that's not what's happening…
She could be right about that. Meisho Doto isn't the only one who is stagnating.
But one day, Meisho Doto will see this for herself and awaken.
choice_data_list: If only we could repeat what happened last fall.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That won't happen. Probably.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Try to remember what actually happened last fall.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Doto didn't spark that awakening. She just let it happen to her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: After my accident, when I dropped out of racing… Doto got pressured into changing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: She's not going to take the initiative to change on her own. Because… she's too nice to make an enemy out of her idol.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: She knows it, and we do too. Far too well.
…She's right. Meisho Doto would never make that decision on her own.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: If she's going to truly awaken to her full potential—if she's to become the person she wants to be…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Someone else will have to give her the push. Even if that makes them the villain.
It's clear to me now that I need to sit down with Meisho Doto before the Japan Cup… no matter what.
